visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a medium shot of ButterBear, a fluffy yellow bear mascot, on a brightly lit stage. The mascot wears a white tank top with 'Acer' and 'ButterBear' branding, green athletic shorts, and a matching headband. It performs cute hand-to-face gestures against a yellow and blue 'Acer Day' backdrop. (2) The camera pans to reveal a massive crowd within a multi-level modern shopping mall. Fans are leaning over railings on the second floor, and the ground floor is packed with people holding up smartphones to record the event. Bright indoor lights and colorful 'Register' signs are visible. (3) Transitioning outdoors, a sleek black Mercedes-Benz van pulls up to a curb lined with lush green trees. A man in a professional black suit stands by as the side door slides open to reveal ButterBear inside. A woman in a white T-shirt helps the mascot step out onto the pavement. (4) Back inside the venue, ButterBear interacts with a female host on stage. The host wears a light green crop top and a white pleated skirt. The mascot mimics her movements, waving its paws and spinning around. Large industrial-style air coolers are positioned nearby to manage the indoor temperature. (5) A sequence of shots shows ButterBear performing a coordinated dance routine to an upbeat rhythm. The mascot shakes its hips and moves its arms rhythmically while the crowd cheers loudly. Multiple professional cameramen with large rigs are seen filming the performance from the front of the stage.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A friendly, high-energy male voice begins a Mandarin narration, describing the excitement of visiting Thailand to see a 'superstar.' Underneath the voice, a cheerful, mid-tempo pop background music track plays, featuring bright synthesizer chords and a steady electronic beat that sets an optimistic and inviting atmosphere. (2) As the scene shifts to the van's arrival, the audio texture changes significantly. A sudden burst of high-pitched collective screaming and cheering from a large crowd dominates the mix, reflecting a high arousal level. The sound of the van's sliding door opening creates a brief mechanical rustle before more applause follows. (3) The audio transitions into a loud, rhythmic Thai pop song with a strong 4/4 electronic drum beat and vibrant synthesizer melodies. A female vocalist sings in Thai while the narrator continues his commentary. The music is synchronized with the mascot's dance movements, creating a high-energy performance environment. (4) Throughout the performance, intermittent sounds of laughter, shouting, and the constant murmur of a large crowd are layered over the music. The narrator's tone remains warm and enthusiastic, concluding with a soft musical fade-out and a playful sign-off as the mascot makes its final cute gestures on the stage.
